scenarios.name: Place an order
scenarios.reason:
Added Colombia Huila to the bag.
Opened the bag and proceeded to checkout.
Entered Ada Lovelace’s name, ada@example.com, and the Lisbon delivery address at 12 Rua Augusta, then placed the order.
The order was confirmed as received, with €17.90 charged: €13.00 for the coffee and €4.90 for shipping.
